title: SAP SuccessFactors Consultant
summary: SAP SuccessFactors consultants set up SAP's cloud HR software for a company, covering employee records or talent processes such as hiring, onboarding, appraisals and pay reviews. They sit in an HR technology project or support team, working with HR users, payroll and integration teams.
dailyDuties: Run workshops with HR teams to capture processes
Configure business rules, workflows and permissions
Prepare and load employee data with import templates
Write test cases and support HR users in testing
Fix tickets raised by HR users
Review the half-yearly SuccessFactors release changes
Train HR users on new screens and steps

skills.expectation: Configure Employee Central: foundation objects, business rules, workflows and role-based permissions
Configure one talent module such as Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance and Goals or Compensation
Run workshops with HR teams and write configuration workbooks
Map hire-to-retire or talent processes as-is and to-be
Prepare, load and check employee data through import templates
Write test cases and support HR users in acceptance testing
Train HR users and explain designs in plain words
Work with HR, payroll, IT and integration teams through each phase
Build simple Integration Center or OData API integrations
Prepare and check data templates and reports in Excel
Handle support tickets and half-yearly release changes
Deliver in SAP Activate phases or sprints

groups.label: A SuccessFactors module (Employee Central or a talent module)

certifications.why: Employee Central certification is required in many SuccessFactors postings, usually through a partner.
